name: kstest_extras
expr: [h_def, p_def, D_def] = kstest2(x, y); [h_lg, p_lg, D_lg] = kstest2(x, y, 'Tail', 'larger'); [h_sm, p_sm, D_sm] = kstest2(x, y, 'Tail', 'smaller'); [h_un, p_un, D_un] = kstest2(x, y, 'Tail', 'unequal'); [h_a, p_a, D_a] = kstest2(x, y, 'Alpha', 0.01);
comment: Sig: kstest2(x, y[, alpha, tail | name-value]). Tail accepts 'unequal' (default), 'larger', 'smaller' (synonyms for 'both', 'right', 'left' from kstest). Name-Value pairs: 'Alpha', 'Tail'. Closes audit/findings/stats/{kstest,kstest2}.md.
